name: hud_ui_background_video_widget_set_color_key565
description: HudUiBackgroundVideoWidget::SetColorKey565 stores the 16-bit color key and marks the backing stream as color-keyed when present.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to a coherent HudUiBackground video-widget pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4bfe20 tests stream at this+0x34, ORs bit 1 into stream+0x09 when present, stores the stack color-key argument at this+0x3c, and returns.
The native smoke validates both stream-present and stream-null cases, including the stream flag update and colorKey565 storage.
